label: Android app (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose) on the AXF Android port

structure.purpose: App identity, framework version, targets and the default asset for every slot.
Framework version + template the app was initialized from (Android apps depend on published framework modules, nothing is baked).
Includes the framework as a composite build (framework/android) and shares its version catalog.
Copy of the manifest shipped inside the APK; the kernel reads it at startup.
Hot-swappable assets, one folder per asset type (same JSON as every other port).
Application class: builds the kernel from the manifest, assets and modules.
The single activity: AxfRoot + AppShell + the app's views.
The app's own AxfModule: routes, actions, settings, dialogs.
Composable views registered with the shell.
